exams.blurb: Online course allowing current Part 61 pilots with a flight review to earn a remote pilot certificate without sitting the UAG test.

exams.name: Part 107 Small UAS Recurrent Training
exams.blurb: Free online course remote pilots complete every 24 calendar months to keep Part 107 certificate privileges current.

exams.blurb: FAA-accepted 16-hour refresher course used by certificated flight instructors to renew their certificate every 24 calendar months.

exams.name: The Recreational UAS Safety Test
exams.blurb: Free online safety test that every recreational drone flyer in the United States must pass and carry proof of completion.
